headline: Graphic Designer
tagline: Graphic designer with agency and corporate experience building visual systems, social campaigns, and brand collateral.

skills.label: Core Competencies
skills.items: Visual identity, typography, layout, print production, social/marketing creative, design systems

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Designed 100+ digital and print creatives for employee engagement, branding, recruitment, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Produced banners, standees, certificates, ID cards, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Managed print-ready files including bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy.
Used AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly) for ideation and exploration.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Designed logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses.
Created social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for startups and SMBs.
Used Photoshop and Illustrator for product visuals and marketing assets.

projects.name: Social Campaign for a Fashion Brand
bullets: Designed an Instagram and Facebook series that achieved a 15% increase in follower engagement.

projects.name: Branding Kit for AT Creation Startup
bullets: Created logo, typography, and palette guidelines for an early-stage venture.

education.institution: RGCERT Chandrapur (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University)

emphasis: Led with her recent corporate graphic design experience at Ascent and her social campaign results to match Propacity's need for social media creatives and brand consistency.
omitted: Bounceless UX case study — omitted as the target role is strictly graphic design and social creative focused.
